_comment: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — NOT A REAL SANCTIONS LIST. Fabricated addresses, scores, and categories for control validation only. Do not use for any real screening. Modeled in spirit on nexus-protocol's RestrictionList / OFAC denylist concept.

schema.score: 0-100 risk score; >= risk_ceiling (default 75) is a hard block
schema.categories: sanctioned categories (OFAC_SANCTION, SANCTIONS, TERROR_FINANCING) are an unconditional block regardless of score
